notes.title: Patch notes 2/2/17
notes.content:
- If the game fails to launch because of the lack of any sound devices, a notification will alert the user
- 2nd player keyboard can now be used when accepting player match invites
- Players attempting to exploit the game and select to play as the final boss will instead play as Al Azif
- Improved response to disconnects during online battles
- Improved synchronization issues with online play which prevented attack inputs from being read properly
- Canceling VS PLAYER with a controller no longer causes the controller to stop responding

notes.title: Patch notes 12/14/16
notes.content:
-Fixed issues with rankings being incorrectly overwritten with another player's data
-The continue screen will now respond to START button press
-Replay Info now correctly displays player name

Reminder: We will also be resetting player rankings! I will update this post again once the resets are done.

UPDATE: Ranks reset as of 10:28 AM! Feel free to fight your way to the top again.

UPDATE 2: 12/19 10:30AM: Total VP rankings were reinitiated to get rid of some remaining inaccuracies. Once you play a ranked match, your data will be uploaded accurately onto the overall leaderboard. Since this score simply adds up other scores, this is not a full reset, just a partial one to clean up the Steam leaderboards.

notes.title: Rank resets and patch on 12/14
notes.content:
Stopping by to let you guys know we're looking into issues posted throughout the community hub and are working hard on fixes!

In particular, inconsistencies with online rankings have been fixed on our end but will require a rank reset in order to implement. The rankings of certain players were occasionally being overwritten with other player's ranks, so we feel that a full reset is required to reinstate fairness.

The patch with the fix, as well as the full rank resets, will be deployed [b]Wednesday, 12/14 at 10am[/b].

Thank you for your patience, more fixes will be coming soon!
